subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw commit now to these five named memory roles and per-agent slot overrides as the durable public plugin/config contract?
rationale: The patch is not merely an implementation detail: it establishes new config keys, defaults, inheritance rules, plugin activation semantics, and SDK hook behavior that external plugins and user configurations will depend on.

options.title: Approve the role contract
options.body: Sponsor these five roles, require canonical Doctor migration and explicit role-capability validation, then finish the current PR with exact-head proof.

options.title: Land a generic contract first
options.body: Define a generic manifest-owned slot or capability record through the related API/RFC work, then rebase the memory roles onto that narrower primitive.

options.title: Defer multi-role core support
options.body: Keep the single memory slot for now and close or pause this PR until maintainers are ready to own the expanded public surface.

recommendation.title: Approve the role contract
recommendation.body: Sponsor these five roles, require canonical Doctor migration and explicit role-capability validation, then finish the current PR with exact-head proof.
